patterns.evidence: This field is an object containing specific contact details (phone, office, x_handle). It is embedded directly within the journalist document rather than being a reference to a separate 'contacts' collection, which is a classic example of embedding related data to reduce joins.

This is an array of objects containing full comment data (body, upvotes, commenter info). Instead of storing just an ID to a 'comments' collection, the entire comment object is stored inside the article. This is an embedding pattern used to keep frequently accessed related data together.

This is an array of objects describing media assets (kind, url, caption, credit). The full asset metadata is embedded directly in the article document rather than referencing a separate 'media' collection, allowing the article to be read with its visual context in a single query.

This is an array of ObjectIds referencing the 'sections' collection. It represents a many-to-many relationship where a reader can follow multiple sections. This is a standard referencing pattern for linking user preferences to content categories.

This is an array of ObjectIds referencing the 'journalists' collection. It links an article to multiple authors. This is a standard referencing pattern for many-to-many relationships between articles and people.
This field holds an ObjectId referencing a document in the 'readers' collection. It identifies the user who wrote the comment. This is a direct referencing pattern.
This field holds an ObjectId referencing a document in the 'articles' collection. It identifies which article the comment belongs to. This is a direct referencing pattern.
This field holds an ObjectId referencing a document in the 'sections' collection. It categorizes the article. This is a direct referencing pattern.
This field holds an ObjectId referencing a document in the 'journalists' collection. It identifies the person responsible for the section. This is a direct referencing pattern.

This is a field inside an embedded array. It holds an ObjectId referencing a 'readers' document. While the array itself is embedded, this specific field inside it acts as a reference to another collection.
This is a field inside an embedded array. It holds an ObjectId referencing the parent 'articles' document (self-reference). This is a reference pattern within an embedded structure.
